facts.fact: ANSSI's summary states Loi L/2016/037/AN on cybersecurity and personal data protection was adopted by the National Assembly and promulgated by President Alpha Condé, covering personal data processing by individuals, companies and public institutions; it gives no commencement statement and dates the law to 2016 only (document published 2016, year precision).
